abstract: With the fast evolution of computer technology, the service from search engines has been providing more and more convenience to mobile terminals. However, traditional key-word search engines have their own deficiency on certain areas which take geographical factors into account. To overcome this deficiency, this paper discusses about another new type of search, location-based search. After analyzing the background of Location-Based Service (LBS), this paper proposed the architecture for LBS systems, and put forward a scheme of constructing server database by using spatial index, and finally implemented one application of searching for hotels.

articleTitle: A File Integrity Monitoring System Based on Virtual Machine
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This paper describes the design and implementation of a file integrity monitoring system, named FSGuard, based on the virtualization software Xen. Monitored system (DomU) runs in full virtualized mode on Xen, therefore it is unable to perceive the existence of the underlying VMM, but its system calls related to file operations are recorded in real time. User mode programs in DomU provide configuration and management interface, so that the administrator can assign a certain DomU to specify the access control policy and a list of files that need to be protected. These characters make FSGuard possible to monitor file operations in real time, and get feedback through the user mode program in DomU.

articleTitle: Underdetermined DOA Estimation of LFM Signals
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: A method is proposed to separate received LFM signals on underdetermined hypothesis. In which the sensors is less then the signals to be separated. As LFM signal belongs to nonstationary signal, the proposed method is based on Time Frequency Distribution (TFD) analysis. Through suppressing the cross term of the TFD, auto term become prominent. A rotation way utilizing the auto term points is presented, by which the TFD area of each LFM signal is classified. Using the STFD matrices corresponding to the auto term points, the Direction Of Arrival (DOA) of each LFM signal can be estimated individually. Through simulation, it is proved that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Study on the Effect of Moisture Stress on Printed Circuit Board of Numerical Control System
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This paper studies the effect of moisture stress on insulation resistance (IR) failures of printed circuit board (PCB) for numerical control (NC) purpose under the temperature-humidity-bias conditions. A characteristic of the IR failures is a series of intermittent IR drops, which can severely affect the reliability of NC assemblies. In this paper, all the test multilayer PCBs for NC purpose are subjected to a humidity and heating experiment in a high and low temperature damp heat test chamber, maintained at 40°C throughout the test. Then the effect of moisture stress on NC finished boards is discussed and a relative humidity threshold is predicted from analyzing experimental data which can provide an basis for accelerated life testing of NC PCBs. Conductor spacing is observed to represent a factor in the electrochemical migration (ECM) process, indicating that further study on conductor spacing is required to predict reliability of today's high-density PCBs. The study reveals that the effect of moisture stress on IR is investigated to decrease faults from humidity then improve the quality and reliability of NC circuit boards.

articleTitle: The Design of Intelligent Temperature Transmitter Based on HART Protocol
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Based on the HART protocol, the intelligent temperature transmitter takes microprocessor (MSP430F1611) as the core. In this paper, the development, the definition and the function of HART protocol are introduced. In according to the design and requirements of the HART protocol communication module of the intelligent temperature transmitter, based on the chips of the HART modem (HT1200) and loop-powered DAC (AD421), the software and hardware of HART protocol communication module are designed.

articleTitle: Application of Fibre Channel Technology to Flying Control System
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: With the development of astrionics system with the high integration degree, limit of MIL-STD-1553B comes out on transfer rate, bandwidth and real-time performance. In order to solve the bottleneck, this paper rebuilds the present structure of the flying control system with Fiber Channel, and puts forward a dual-switch redundancy network, discusses the application scheme that how to use Fiber Channel in flying control system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Actual Sampled Data System in Fractional Fourier Transform Domain
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Sampling and reconstruction is a basic issue in signal processing. The known sampling theory in the fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) domain is based on the assumption of ideal uniform impulse train sampling. However, this assumption is not valid for engineering application. This paper analyzes the actual sample-and-hold system in the FRFT domain, and then constructs a new sample-and-hold system in the FRFT domain to recovery the original input signal. The result obtained in this paper realizes the application of the sampling theorem for the FRFT domain in engineering.

articleTitle: Central Air-Conditioning Terminal Intelligent Control System
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: According to the current situation of the traditional central air conditioning system and the technical requirements of the partner, this paper designs and develops a central air conditioning intelligent control system which takes WQ-series PLC as its master controller. Designing three operating modes for the central air conditioning terminal control system and making a detail introduction. This system is based on the size of the absolute deviation between indoor actual temperature and setting temperature, using self-adaptive PID control, environment temperature compensation control, day and night time automatic variable compensation coefficient control and other intelligent control to achieve the following and decoupling control of the flow and temperature and the purpose of energy-saving, creating a good economic and social benefit.

articleTitle: Design of Power Supply System for Field Wireless Sensor Network Nodes
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: A simple power supply solution with solar energy photovoltaic cells is put forward for low-power field devices like wireless sensor network (WSN) nodes for environmental surveillance. In order to reduce the system's power loss and improve the efficiency of solar energy photovoltaic cells, the battery's output characteristics and the leakage current of supercapacitor (SC) are investigated and the power system with matching SCs and solar cells is designed. Then the two-stage energy storage structure including SCs and NIMH batteries are used to store electric power, and the output voltages and currents of power supply are analyzed. The experimental results show that the system can reserve enough energy and meet the long-term power supply requirements of wireless sensor network nodes in the field.

articleTitle: A Research on Famous-User Network of SINA-Weibo
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Analysis over online social network, especially those for network structure analysis, have significant meanings for works including network models' building-up and researches over the transmissional traits. Aiming towards the user relation network oriented from the Famous-User of SINAWeibo, this paper studies many facets including the degree distribution, small-world phenomenon and degree correlation utilizing the complex network analysis algorithms, with experimental results showing for this network the existence of deviations from power-law at the degree distribution level, the effective diameter being short, the nodes' degrees being irrelevant, with the non-hierarchical intrinsic nature proved.

articleTitle: Direction-of-arrival estimation for arbitrary array configurations in ultra-wideband
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In this paper, in order to solve the problem that antennas and sensors of different guidance mode used less space of the antenna plate aperture in the multi-mode composite guidance (MCG) passive radar seeker (PRS),a new algorithm for direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation for arbitrary array configurations is proposed. Unlike most of the work available in the open literature, the antennas are placed in the same plane, we consider the case which may be disposed on a conformal surface, may have unknown (but fixed) geometries. The proposed estimator is computed using four antennas as a solution, the azimuth and elevation are estimated by the matrix inversion. The simulation result verifies the effectiveness in direction finding performance of this method by comparing the arbitrary-dimensional baseline algorithm, which is based on 3-D array with 2-D array. The solving ambiguous probability(SAP) from 1 GHz to 15 GHz of the conformal antenna mounted on anti-radar missile (ARM) is greater than 75%, and the direction finding error is less than 0.16°. The test based on actual direction finding system in the proposed algorithm proved that it can get well performance in real-world.

articleTitle: The Basic Principle and FPGA Implementation of NCO
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In the digital signal processing, the NCO (Numerically Controlled Oscillators) has a wide range of applications. In this paper, we have researched and implemented the NCO based on the lookup table algorithm with the VHDL and the ISE tool of Xilinx Inc. Finally, the simulation results indicate that the designed NCO is suitable.

articleTitle: Evaluating Node Importance in Complex Network Based on Enron Database
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: With the development of social networks, how to evaluate the importance of node has become an important problem. In this paper, a method of evaluating node importance is proposed based on Email network model. The hierarchical structure is considered during this method and the corresponding evaluation model is proposed also. To illustrate the effect of this method, the difference is compared between it and classic approach, such as degree centrality, closeness centrality and betweenness centrality.

articleTitle: A Parallel Algorithm to Find Overlapping Community Structure in Directed and Weighted Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Based on the BSP (Bulk Synchronous Parallel) computing framework, this paper proposes a parallel algorithm to find overlapping community structure in directed and weighted complex networks. The algorithm is composed of four parts, job distribution, finding natural communities, passing information in cluster and merging the similar natural communities. The main idea of the algorithm is finding the local maxima of a modularity function by local, iterative search to ensure that each vertex in network at least belongs to one natural community. By iteratively merging the similar natural communities we get a series of schemes and choose the scheme which results in the maximum modularity as the best scheme. By using Hama which is a pure BSP computing framework, we conduct experiments in several real networks. The results show the algorithm can give an original scheme very fast and give the best scheme with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology in the Maintenance Training System of Mobile Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Aimed at the present maintenance training in the army, the virtual maintenance training system frame of a certain type of power station was designed by using the object model and virtual reality technology. The key technologies to build simulation models based on NGrain were studied, and the virtual maintenance training system was developed finally. Results show that the system has lots of advantages such as multiple training modes, friendly operation and low requests to hardware.

articleTitle: A Novel and Intelligent Integrated-distributed Measurement Platform for Multi-sensors
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The measurement of variety of non-electricity such as temperature and humidity is so important. To measure the temperature and humidity accurate with low cost is especially necessary. An open platform for multi-sensors including temperature and humidity etc. Measurement and control is proposed. Three layers distributed architecture is adopted, and the distributed intelligent nodes are designed. All nodes are connected to the embedded computer through RS-485 and the data processing is accomplished. The software is developed with WinCE and good user interface is obtained. Other sensor modules are also supported and processed in the open platform. The results of application show that the platform is of low-cost, good openness, versatility and supporting complex industrial applications.

articleTitle: Multi-user Detection Based on Tabu Simulated Annealing Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: To design an optimal multiuse detector of low complexity and resolve local convergent problem, a hybrid approach that employs a genetic algorithm (GA) and a simulated annealing (SA) and a tabu search (TS) for multi-user detection problem in Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) communications system is proposed. Using this approach, a genetic algorithm is used to provide a good initial value of tabu search, because the initial value is very important for the performance of a tabu search. Additionally, we apply simulated annealing (SA) to GA and design self-adaptation crossover probability and mutation probability according to simulated annealing ideas. Using this method can make the new detector avoid local optimum and gradually convergent to the feasible globally optimal solution. We called the new detector tabu simulate annealing genetic algorithm (TSAGA). Simulation results for the synchronous case are provided to show that the proposed TSAGA detector has significant performance improvements over the conventional detectors.

articleTitle: Color Image Retrieval System Based on Shape and Texture Watermarks
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) is one of the most exciting and fastest-growing areas in the field of multimedia technology. In this Letter, we apply the watermarking technique into the retrieval system and propose a novel approach for JEPG image retrieval. The proposed image retrieval system consists of two main phases, offline process and online retrieval process. The feature vector is extracted from each image as the watermark to be embedded into the image, which is the preprocessing operation called offline process. It doesn't require decompressing the JPEG images but directly embedding the watermark in the DCT domain. The online retrieval process consists of three processes, i.e., query feature computation, watermark extraction and feature vector matching. Since the features are embedded in the image data, it is unnecessary to compute the features but only to extract it from the watermarked image. We carry out a series of experiments on a watermarked image database, and the detailed comparison results between the novel approach and the traditional system indicate the advantage of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Real-Time Measurement of Explosion True Temperature
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: A kind of multi-spectral pyrometer has been developed for large explosive environment. The fiber-optic long-distance transmission technique and fiber coupling technique have also been applied for the first time in the optical system design, which, to a large extent, reduces the anti-vibration, anti-explosion and anti-electromagnetic interference for the main body of the pyrometer. The pyrometer was used to measure the true temperature curve of TNT explosive. The analysis of its measurement uncertainty is also given.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Netflow Data Collection System
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Netflow-based network traffic analysis is one of today's mainstream network traffic monitoring and analysis techniques. However, port-based traffic identification that employed in Netflow-based protocol analysis is inaccurate. Netflow cannot provide enough details for analysis of site access behaviour. In order to overcome the above limitation, we propose an enhanced Netflow data collection method combining packet capturing and flow technique for accurate application identification. Then we design and implement an enhanced Netflow data collection system, which lays a data foundation for traffic analysis. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the system are verified.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Real-Time Spectrum Analysis System Based on DSP Builder
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: A method of designing real-time spectrum analysis based on FPGA is put forward in this article and the characteristic of the FFT_IP core is described in detail. This system uses the Altera DSP Builder tool converting the built algorithm model into the hardware description language of FPGA directly. It ensures that FFT algorithm model based on FPGA reduce the difficulty of development and design, and it is easy to modify and test. Verilog hardware description language is used to realize the sampling control, loading data and VGA display driver. Finally, the program is simulated in Quartus II software tools, and realized on FPGA. The practice shows that the spectrum analysis system is applied to the system on the real-time requirements strictly.

articleTitle: The Predicative Analysis Method Based on ADS of the Anti-interference Performance of the VHF Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In this paper, the use of the Advanced Design System(ADS) simulation software, we build the behavior-lever model of the VHF transceiver, this paper first build the transmit and receive model of Very High Frequency(VHF) transceiver as Amplitude Modulation(AM), we first simulate the VHF transceiver under the ideal state, and after that, we analysis the VHF transceiver's signal-to-noise ratio and the noise threshold by adding the different interference signal, proposed the method of performance prediction analysis of the VHF transceiver.

articleTitle: Shipboard Aircraft Arresting System Modeling and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Shipboard arresting gear is a special aero-carrier unit that is designed to provide an efficient arrestment of the deck jet-fighters of masses 15-25 tons with landing velocities between 180 and 240 km/h. In the current paper, a full-scale arresting system model is created. Main elements of the arresting system consist of cables and hydraulic system. The model contains all basic elements of the real prototype and is employed to analyze the dynamic behavior of the arresting gear with different scenarios. The stroke of cam is enlarged to increase the capacity of arresting gear. The finite element methodology is employed to analyze the dynamic behavior of cables. The developed model is used to obtain parameters of the arresting process - fighter displacement, velocity, acceleration vs. time, as well as pressure in the hydraulic system and tensile force in the cable.

articleTitle: h-Stability for Difference Systems
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Pinto introduced the notion of h-stability. This notion is very useful because, when we study the asymptotic stability of difference systems it is not easy to work with non-exponential types of stability. Medina and Pinto applied the h-stability to obtain a uniform treatment for the various stability notions in difference systems and gave new insights about stability for weakly stable difference systems. In this paper, first, we introduce the background, the current situation of studies for h-stability. Second, we give some definition about h-stability and some lemmas. Finally, we prove that the two concepts of h-stability and h-stability in variation are equivalent via n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> - imilarity and Lyapunov function.

articleTitle: 2-D DOA Estimation of Improved Toeplitz Algorithms to Coherent Sources
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: An improved algorithm is proposed for Direction-Of-Arrival (DOA) estimation of coherent signals on a ULA, which get new covariance matrix by reconstructing a Toeplitz matrix using the observed data vector rather than getting covariance matrix directly by observed date vector. Traditional decorrelation algorithms are based on ULA. They can only find the one-dimensional (1-D) direction of arrival angles (DOAs). This paper employs the three orthogonal uniform linear arrays to find the 2-D direction of arrival angles. Simulation results verify that the proposed algorithm has better performance than the spatial smoothing MUSIC at the same simulating condition.

articleTitle: Control System of Two-phase Brushless DC Gyro Motor Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The research of the influence of gyro motor speed stability on the north-seeking result is studied in order to improve the gyro north-finding precision. The paper introduces a two-phase brushless DC gyro motor control system based on TMS320LF2407A. First it expounds the two-phase brushless DC motor's working principle. Then through the design of the hardware and software system, the two-phase brushless DC gyro motor control is realized. The experimental results show that: the system can drive the brushless DC gyro motor starting, braking and smoothly running. The precision of the steady speed is less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> and the characteristics of the system satisfy the gyroscope demand.

articleTitle: A Union Node Localization Algorithm Based on RSSI and DV-Hop for WSNs
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: RSSI localization algorithm and DV-Hop localization algorithm are the typical representatives of the range-based and free-range localization algorithm of wireless sensor networks respectively. In this paper, the reasons for localization error caused by the RSSI localization algorithm and DV-Hop localization algorithm are analyzed, on this basis, a union node localization algorithms based on RSSI and DV-Hop is put forward, in order to decrease the ranging error, the method of measure distance is chosen based on hop count. The implementation process of the union localization algorithm is supplied, and the performance of the algorithm is simulated. The simulation results show that the positioning accuracy of the union localization algorithm has significantly improved.

articleTitle: Design of Real-time Monitoring and Visualization Management System Based on RFID and Java EE
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In this paper, a visualization management systems are designed based on RFID technology and Java EE web technology. This system includes hardware design and software design. The parts of hardware design could get the position of the tracking equipment with the RFID automatic identification technology which is used to achieve real-time collection of data so as to realize real-time, tracking and monitoring. The software platform is designed based on Java EE technologies which are used to establish three-layer architecture based on B/S. The paper focus on the research of transport protocol between the RFID Reader and RFID tags, and SSH framework platform in web technologies. Then, a visual and graphical interface is introduced to show and monitor the status and the position of equipment in real-time.

articleTitle: Frame Design of SC-FDE System for Noise Suppression Used in UAV Data Link
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The wireless communication in the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) data link faces serious multi path fading, which leads to frequency-selective fading and inter-symbol interference and affects the quality of data transmission. Single Carrier Frequency Domain Equalization (SC-FDE) is an effective method to mitigate the influence of multipath fading. Frame structure is essential in wireless communication system, and the design of frame affects synchronization and channel-estimation. The paper introduces SC-FDE system firstly, and then the design of frame structure in SC-FDE and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is given. Many researches have been made in this area. In this paper, we present several frame structures. The brief structures and their advantages are given.

articleTitle: Speech Length Threshold in Forensic Speaker Comparison by Using Long-Term Cumulative Formant (LTCF) Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Long-Term Formant distribution (LTF) is a relatively new method in forensic speaker comparison, by which the results have been proved to contain important speaker-specific information. However, few studies have been carried out for the fundamental issue that how long the speech sample should be collected. The current paper investigated the speech length threshold (SLT) by using Long-Term Cumulative Formants (LTCF) analysis, which was one of the LTF methods. The speech sample for each speaker was segmented into one-second length sub samples. Pearson's correlation coefficients were calculated for LTCF values of the whole speech sample and new set of speech samples that were formed by adding the immediately following sub sample onto the speech sample before it with a start from the first sub sample. The results show that SLT can be placed at about 70 seconds natural speech recordings (approximate 20 seconds only vocalic samples in duration), which are adequate to represent the whole vocal tract resonance characteristics.

articleTitle: Design of Human Biomedical Signal Simulator Based on the SOPC
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: With the improvement of people's living standard, the demand of strengthening their health is increasing day by day. The emergence of multi-parameter monitor will always check whether the body's normal physiological parameters. However, with the increase of biomedical monitors, Functional testing of biomedical monitor are gradually strengthened. This paper designs a multi-parameter, high-performance, low power portable instrumentation, biomedical signal simulator. The system uses SOPC technology will integrate in one CPU, and design digital logic and distinctive Signal conditioning circuit in order to achieve technical indicators and monitoring functions, and achieve a variable resistance and increase the self-checking system. The paper designs the detailed waveform circuit, signal conditioning circuit and biomedical signal detection circuit, finally the system simulates various biomedical signal waveforms and show the data output by the man-machine interface. The system can be accomplished conveniently and quickly by using Altera Quartus II, SOPC Builder and Nios II IDE software. In a word, hardware design is more flexible than before, and system upgrades more and more convenient.

articleTitle: Semi-Definite Programming Based Pulse Shaping Algorithm in IEEE 802.15.4a
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In order to increase the peak transmission data rate of Zigbee and expand its application scenario, IEEE 802.15.4a standard has been proposed in 2007, and ultra-wideband (UWB) technique has been selected as one of its physical layer standard. The performance of wireless sensor networks (WSN) will be affected by the pulse waveform transmitted in the channel, hence, in this paper, the Chinese regulation for UWB devices is firstly given, and then, a semi-definite programming based pulse shaping algorithm to comply with such regulation is proposed. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can comply with the given regulation with high power efficiency, which can increase the signal to noise ratio (SNR) in the receiver end.

articleTitle: The Design of Single-phase Variable Frequency Power Supply with APFC
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Around the above problem, the new power supply is designed. In the design, L6562 is used to control the APFC circuit, and EG8010 is used to control full-bridge inverter circuit. According to the design requirements, firstly, the parameter calculation and the device selection are completed. Then, Saber software is used to simulate the active power factor correction circuit and the inverter circuit. At the same time, the parameters of input power factor and output load regulation rate are calculated to validate the rationality of the calculated devices and the feasibility of the design circuit. At last, the hardware circuit is built and tested. In a word, the designed power supply is available and efficiency, because it can not only achieve the function of changing frequency, but also have the result of power factor correction.

articleTitle: Simulation and Test of Finite Capability Power System
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The paper sets up simulation and test system of relationship of electric load and power supply of finite capability power system based on research status quo of this question. This system can analysis the mutual influence of electric load and power supply and can be used for the design or choice of power supply equipment.

articleTitle: Implementation of Anchor Mechanism for Convergence Services Triggering
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In this paper, the anchor mechanism is proposed to implement the triggering control of convergence services between CS (Circuit Switch) domain and IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) domain. The background, key issues and research solutions about triggering of convergence services are introduced. To achieve services triggering, the anchor control platform with call redirection and signing control function between CS and IMS is designed. After analyzing the process that anchor mechanism completes services triggering and offers consistent services regardless of accessing from CS or IMS, the paper evaluates the effects in real-application domains. Thus anchor mechanism is demonstrated to be an ideal solution for the coexistence period of CS domain and IMS domain, exhibiting practical feasibility and application value.

articleTitle: Study of Multi-channel Signal Source Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Studying on the structure and function of signal source, combined with the features of the current signal source and the needs for multi-channel signal source, a design of a multi-channel signal source is given in this paper. It is realized by the integrated DDS circuit in the FPGA chip, high-speed DA conversion chip, amplifying circuit and filter circuit etc. It has been proved that it can generate standard sin signal which has adjustable frequency, amplitude and phase. The frequency range is 0~125M Hz, amplitude resolution 0.1V and phase resolution π/512.

articleTitle: Normal Vector of the 3D Point Cloud Estimates and Close to the Point Normal Vector Adjustment Methods
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The normal vector is one of the important properties of the 3D point cloud data, estimation methods have been important research in the field. The normal vector estimation is the basis of the 3D point cloud subsequent follow-up of the light treatment, curvature calculation and surface reconstruction. Introduced an automatic space by greatly increasing the speed of the point cloud neighborhood search, given the fast and efficient point cloud normal vector estimation and adjustment algorithm based on the normal vector near the point, the experiments show the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Direct Method for Trajectory Planning of Electromagnetic Formation Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Formation flying with inter-satellite electromagnetic force offers an attractive alternative to tradition propellant-based technology for space missions due to its prominent advantages. Trajectory planning for the formation reconfiguration is considered as an optimal control problem, and addressed using a direct method that bases on inverse dynamics in the virtual domain. By mapping the physical trajectory from time to virtual domain, the optimization of spatial trajectory and speed profile is decoupled. The reconfiguration trajectory is parameterized using a polynomial in the virtual domain, while some of the coefficients are firsthand determined according to the given boundary conditions. Thus the trajectory planning problem is converted into the optimization of few varied parameters. Numerical results are discussed to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed planning method.

articleTitle: The SQIM Model to Improve Software Credibility
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Trust computing has become a hot research issue in recent years. Due to the lack of separation of concerns, OOP-based software systems have some redundant code and programming logic disorders, which increase the burden of maintenance of the software. In this paper, we present a software quality improvement model - the SQIM model, which improves the system's credibility by using AOP technology.

articleTitle: Improved Received Method of 1/3-CPCK Systems Based on Pre-FrFT-Filter and Coherent Demodulation
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Using very minimum frequency shift chirp (VMFS-chirp) signal as carrier, 1/3 continuous phase chirp keying (1/3-CPCK) has high bandwidth efficient and has been used in bandwidth-limited wireless communication. With high correlation between 1/3-CPCK carriers, the ability of noise suppression in 1/3-CPCK system was low. In order to solve this problem, an improved received method of 1/3-CPCK system was presented in the paper. Using the difference of convergent between VMFS-chirp signal and additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) in FrFT domain, the improved received method used pre-FrFT-filter (instead of general band-pass filter)before coherent demodulation to suppress AWGN. The difference of convergent was analyzed, and then the improved received method model was built and simulated. Theoretical analysis and simulation results showed that comparing present receiver method with band-pass filter and coherent demodulation, the improved received method has stronger ability of noise suppression and got more than 2dB processing gain.

Author Keywords: very minimum frequency shift chirp (VMFS- chirp)

articleTitle: Research on the Academic Management System (AMS) Based on WEB Design
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The AMS based on the internet can improve the work efficiency to some extent and provide all kinds of academic administration information timely, which has standardized the academic administration and has been playing a very important role in school management. Based on Web service system, this thesis designs the AMS which suits the information age and may help improve the construction of the digital campus constantly.

articleTitle: The Design of Truck Steelyard Automatic Acquisition System in Forestry
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This abtract introduce that Truck steelyard which controlled by AT89C51 automatic acquisied the weight of truck of shipping materials, automatic detected the up or down truck steelyard and automatic identificated the truck's number, then through the computer network to transport the data information to the main management department safe. At present, the system has been successfully and safely applied in safety digitizing managing wood-produce by YiChun Forestry Bureau and JiaGeDaQi Forestry Bureau using.

articleTitle: Fractional Fourier Transform Operators under Different Kernel Sampling Matrixes and the Applications in Image Encryption
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: A novel method for the image encryption based on the Fractional Fourier Transform (FRFT) is proposed in this paper. Different sampling matrixes are introduced to analysis the multiplicity of the FRFT. This property is also used for the design of the encryption algorithm here. Good performance in the experiments shows its efficiency.

articleTitle: Simulations of Transverse Velocity Distributions of CR Atomic Beam Truncated by a Three-aperture Pre-collimating Slit
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Transverse velocity distributions of Cr atomic beam truncated by a novel three-aperture pre-collimating slit, with and without one-dimensional transverse laser cooling, are presented. The simulations ware performed using Monte Carlo particle-optics approach, taking into account of the isotopes, distribution of longitudinal velocity and transverse divergence. The results showed that the atomic beam had a velocity distribution in the range of ±3m/s and ±1m/s, without and with laser cooling. Consequently, the transverse divergence is 0.77mrad and 0.27mrad, respectively. In addition, with an assumption that only <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">52</sup>Cr atoms interact with the cooling laser, the existence of other isotopes will decrease the maximum value of the velocity, and increase the background.

articleTitle: Analysis of Aviation Networks Structure Based on Complex Networks Theory
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The development of economy and information technology has increased the scale of aviation networks and enhanced the complex interaction in the network. Therefore the study of aviation networks has become the hot research issue in the international research academy. The complex networks theory which is highly abstracted from complex system has been researched thoroughly. Thus, it is used here to analyze the structure of aviation networks. First of all, the topological features of complex aviation networks are analyzed. Then the spatial distribution of Chinese aviation network is researched according to the indices of degree, clustering coefficient, accessibility, and so on. At last, the analysis shows that Chinese aviation network is a "Small World" networks whose center is the airports with large degree. The network analysis model proposed here directs the improvement of Chinese aviation network development.

articleTitle: Amplitude Normalization Calibration Method for Antenna Channel Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In the passive direction finding system, the performance of the spatial spectrum estimation algorithm will be significantly reduced due to mismatch between the ideal signal model and actual signal environments. In this paper, we analyze reasons for angular resolution and direction precision decrease of the Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC) algorithm, build an actual mathematic model of antenna receiving signals based on amplitude and phase errors, and propose a real-time calibration method for channel uncertainty based on amplitude normalization and phase 0° calibration. According to this method, the performance of the MUSIC algorithm is improved by suppressing the random noise and increasing the precision and angular resolution of the MUSIC algorithm. Simulation results and experimental results verify the correctness of this method.

articleTitle: Fast Attitude Maneuver of Spacecraft Based on Variable Structure Control
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This article chooses large reconnaissance satellites with ultrahigh resolution power for study. It describes the mathematical model of the satellites and proposes a control algorithm based on multi-mode switching of control moment gyros. The proposed algorithm is effective to avoid the singularity of control moment gyros while making the satellite achieve fast attitude maneuver. Sliding-mode variable structure controller is designed to minimize the error attitude and further accelerates the attitude convergence speed. At last, referring to the vibration equation, a strain rate feedback controller is used to suppress the satellite vibration quickly. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is illustrated with a numerical simulation example.

articleTitle: Implementation of Medium Access Control Protocol to Improve Quality of Service in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This paper proposes WTRP-S, a Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol based on WTRP and for wireless sensor networks. It guarantees QoS and controls the energy consumption which is required in wireless sensor networks. The protocol let the node shut down the wireless communication module when no data is sent, which will not affect token passing. The experiment compares the performance of WTRP-S, WTRP and IEEE802.15.4 MAC in the same network, and shows that WTRP-S provides a better QoS and is more suitable for energy-limited wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: The Design and Research of Reversing System Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In view of the current reversing safety problem, this paper studies the reversing system based on Android. The system loads USB device driver in the Linux kernel module of the Android's camera, uses V4L2 interface to access the drive and recompiles the dynamic library to update the root file system of Android. Therefore, the system realizes the interaction between Android platform and USB camera and then completes the reversing system on Android platform.

articleTitle: Research on the Criterion Workout of Maintenance Equipment Ration for General Radar Based on Reliability
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The equipment ration criterion is the foundation of making supply plans as well as achieving scientific and information-based equipment support. It states in the paper about the workout flow and rules of the criterion, the demand calculation model of general radar equipment based on reliability, which would improve the criterion workout only dependent on experts' experience before. In the end, the software system was developed based on the Microsoft SQL and Delphi tools, according to the modularized, intelligentized as well as general-purpose principles, which is friendly and works well to fulfill the criterion workout of general radar equipment ration.

articleTitle: Polarization Code Shift Keying OCDMA System Using Polarization Modulator
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: For the first time, we propose a novel polarization orthogonal modulation format with code-shift keying (CSK) generated by polarization modulator. And we demonstrate a temporal phase encoded OCDMA system using novel polarization CSK (Polm-CSK) data format and balanced detection. The proposed scheme has fixed threshold with variation of users number, improved receiving sensitivity, realization simplicity, and particularly enhanced security compares with conventional OCDMA systems.

articleTitle: Two-Degree Controller Design for Flexible Missile Based on H-inf Interference Suppression
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: A flexible missile is researched in this paper. A model of flexible missile containing rigid motion and undesired vibration signal is derived in the pitch channel. The pitch-angle and pitch-rate form the inputs of the controller. The vibration signals are regarded as the interference signals. The problem of interference suppression is regarded as the problem of standard H-inf control, and then we design a two-degree controller. Simulation results show that the two-degree controller can restrain the vibration signals and measurement noise well.

articleTitle: Real-time Performance Analysis of Missile-borne Computer Embedded System Based on the ARM
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: First introduced the two-dimensional trajectory correction projectile shot contained a computer software program design. Pointed out on this foundation in the two-dimensional trajectory correction projectile using operating system is to overcome the traditional shortcomings of the important approach to software development. Then it is elaborated the popular military real-time embedded operating system. At the same time, in accordance with the two-dimensional trajectory correction projectile missile-borne computer software program design requirements were compared. The experiment results show that using real time operating system of missile-borne computer in real-time performance can meet the requirements.

articleTitle: The Research of Feature Extraction Methods in the Tomatoes Detection
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Feature selection can reduce the feature space dimension and improve recognition. In the discriminatory fresh degree of tomatoes by electronic nose, it used three kinds of feature extraction methods: sheath coefficient characteristics, similitude entropy characteristics and the energy characteristics, and the three methods were compared respectively. The results showed that similitude entropy characteristics feature extraction methods has its advantages in electronic nose detection.

articleTitle: Key Parameter Oriented Performance Meta-Model of Avionics System
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Avionics system has strict requirement for real-time, reliability and resources utilization, so performance analysis is very important at the design stage. There is no special modeling language in avionics domain. It's comparatively complex to use standard UML to model avionics system. Through analyzing features of avionics and MARTE stereotypes, this article puts forward a key parameter oriented meta-model for avionics system performance modeling and validates the usability by an example.

articleTitle: Analysis of Channel Dynamic Delay Effect on Satellite Navigation Channel Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Running satellite navigation channel simulation system for satellite navigation system simulation has many kinds of benefits, such as reserving the signal characteristic of satellite or signal source, adapting to navigation signal structure variation, and distinguishing the final impacts on satellite navigation system performance made by navigation signal source and channel characteristic apart. First of all, the structure of environment-simulation channel in channel simulation system is introduced in this paper, then the impacts on system simulation made by environment-simulation channel dynamic delay is analyzed, and the expression of the error resulting from dynamic delay when simulating single point positioning and timing, and single channel common-view time transfer, is derived.

articleTitle: The Research of Law Enforcement Recorder Application with Motion Detection
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Traditional digital video makes a big space to disk in the long time HD video. This paper puts forward a kind of intelligent video method based on motion detection technology. This method has independent process and it can run with the main program of the digital video. Meanwhile it can read Yuv420P streaming video from CMOS Sensor and code in H.264 standard. The new method in this paper imports alarm message queue and monitoring mechanism. It uses the result to choose H.264 video frame and saves it as AVI. According to the test, on the premise of ensuring the integrity of information, the program not only has nice portability, but also saves disk space greatly.

articleTitle: Using Data Mining Techniques to Promote On-line Shopping Platform
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This article states advantage of using data mining techniques to promote on-line shopping platform both in market and customers for corporation. Achieving market information for the corporation is available by using data mining. Potential customers can also be developed by applying data mining. The corporation can acquire amounts of decisions and market strategies at the end of data mining cycle.

articleTitle: A New Method for the 3-D Discrete Hartley Transform
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In this correspondence, we propose a vector-radix algorithm for fast computation of 3-D discrete Hartley transform(DHT). For data sequences whose length is a power of three, a radix-3×3×3 decimation in frequency algorithm is developed. It decomposes a length-N×N×N DHT into twenty-seven length-(N/3)×(N/3)×(N/3) DHTs. Comparison of computational complexity with known algorithms shows that the proposed algorithm, in some cases, reduces significantly the number of arithmetic operation.

articleTitle: Design of Security Privilege Mechanism Based on Attribute Certificate in UMTS Network
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In this paper we analyze traditional authentication method based on certificate in mobile network environment. This paper proposes a privilege management system based on attribute certificate in mobile network environment. The system uses attribute certificate which is a high security privilege management method to prove user privilege in large scale applications. The use of attribute certificate, distribute OCSP service and USIM support are also discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Laser-induced Breakdown Spectroscopy Sensor System for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: A miniature laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) sensor system for internet of things (IOT) is reported. This system is composed of a micro circuit subsystem and an optical fiber laser subsystem. Power supply, control, refrigeration, optical grating spectrometer, radio frequency identification (RFID), and ZigBee module are integrated into the micro circuit subsystem. All optical components are included in the optical fiber laser subsystem. The LIBS signals of certain tissues, such as nail, hair, etc, of the users stimulated by the infrared pulse laser can be collected, processed and transmitted by this IOT sensor system. This LIBS information can supply some healthy conditions and then be diagnosed by the remote medical experts.

articleTitle: High Gain and Wide Dynamic Range Front-end Receiver for Weak Signal Acoustic Detector
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The novel acoustic analog front-end receiver chip basing all-CMOS technology was designed to amplify the weak signal depressed the harmonic distortion and interference of adjacent channels for multi-channel acoustic imaging system. The 48 channel variable gain amplifiers (VGA) with the exponential gain control, multi-channel output data strobe, output buffer and continuous-time and anti-aliasing fourth-order Butterworth low pass filter for high signal-noise-ration (SNR) of analog-to-digital convertor (ADC), and integrated a vertical shift register. By the simulation verification, processing and test, the system shown linearity gain dynamic range 52dB, the equivalent input noise 5.2nV /Hz1/2@ 1.5MHz, and - 3dB bandwidth on 15MHz~92MHz. When the gain was less than 55dB, the second-order harmonic distortion was less than - 40dB, the receiving sensitivity 50μV while signal to noise ration (SNR) 30dB, the power consumption of each channel 6mW at 5V power supply.

articleTitle: Further Improved Deep Differential Fault Analysis on Camellia
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This paper presents a further improved deep differential fault analysis (DFA) on Camellia. The proposed method can extend the single byte based fault depth into the r-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> round, recover full 8 bytes of the rth round equivalent key, 5-6 bytes of the r-1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> round equivalent key, and 1 byte of the r-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> round equivalent key at one time. Experimental results show that: due to the Feistel structure and permutation function design, Camellia is vulnerable to deep DFA attack. 4 and 20 faulty ciphertexts can reduce the key space of Camellia-128 and Camellia-192/256 to 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22.2</sup> and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21.2</sup> respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Implementation of Spaceborn Viterbi Decoder
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In order to meet requirements of BER of satellite-to-ground and satellite-to-satellite communication in space TT&C communication system, this paper investigates the FPGA real-time implementation technology of space-borne Viterbi decoder algorithm. A novel method based on dual-port RAM is proposed as the survivor path management solution. Besides, a series of methods, such as path-cutting, parallelized Adding-Comparison-Selection computing and soft-decision, are adopted to further improve the performance of Viterbi decoding. Compared to the conventional decoder, the Viterbi decoder based on XC2V6000-4 FPGA has advantages of short delay, good real-time performance and low hardware complexity with the speed of maximum output data rate to 116Mbps.

articleTitle: Design of Portable Fault Diagnosis Device for Electric Locomotive
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: A portable fault diagnosis device for electric locomotive, which is online operational, is introduced in this paper. It realizes fault analysis and diagnosis, fault information storage and fault treatment method prompting for locomotive. Both software and hardware structure of this device is elaborated in this paper, especially the realization of fault diagnosis methods, data acquisition and communication. The device can effectively improve the speed of fault judgment and process, meanwhile reduce the performance impact of different kinds of fault, therefore, meets the actual demand of locomotive operation and the development trend of automation.

articleTitle: Whole Field Out-of-plane Displacement Measurement on Curved Surface Using a Single Camera in Buckling Experiment
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The variation of modality of a specimen plays an important role in a buckling experiment. However, it is not easy to obtain a whole field measurement by most traditional manners in some particular experimental condition. In this paper, we develop a simple method for out-of-plane displacement measurement on a curved surface using one camera. An algorithm based on LDC (Line Detection using Contours) is used to detect corners. The out-of-plane displacement is then determined by a geometrical method on the captured images. And by using multiple scales method, the problem of the variable prospective shrink rate on a curved surface is simplified. Experiments of buckling specimens with curved surface demonstrate that this method is simple, accurate and suitable for measurement of out-of-plane displacement in the limited experimental conditions.

articleTitle: Dynamic Task-Scheduling Algorithm in CNC System Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Based on the architecture of the cloud computing, we establish a distributive CNC system, and analysis differences of the task request between the general cloud computing and the CNC system, then we propose a dynamic feedback scheduling-algorithm in order to realize tasks scheduling. In this dynamic feedback algorithm, every task has a weight value, which is expressed by a vector, in order to express the different request of the different resource. Quantization analysis of the resource request is used to select the best node to accomplish the task, and the optimization selection can achieves the purpose that improving the usage of the resource and reducing the average response time of tasks. Lastly, the simulation results verify the feasibility and the availability of the algorithm in distributive algorithm.

articleTitle: The Application of 3S Technology in the Marine Fishery Resources Research
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This paper introduces theories related to 3S technology, i.g., remote sensing (RS), geographic information system (GIS) and global positioning system (GPS). We mainly discuss the application of 3S technology in the fishing, aquaculture, marine environmental monitoring, firshing boat navigating and other fields, and survey the comprehensive prospect of 3S technology in the field of marine fishery resources study. In conclusion, we point out that the comprehensive application of 3S technology will be a trend for marine fishery modernization, and 3S technology will also provide the theoretical basis for marine fishery research.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Data Fusion Method Based on the D-S theory of Evidence
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: A fusion algorithm for network security situational awareness is proposed based on D-S theory of evidence, processing the vulnerability data from network scanning and host scanning. Though normalizing the vulnerability data, we constructed the corresponding basic probability assignment and fusion the data, fully used the redundancy and complementarity of multisource data, and integrated the results got by different scanning means. The results showed that this method obtained more comprehensive and reliable results.

articleTitle: An Improved Hybrid P2P Control Model Based on Chord
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Traditional hybrid P2P Botnet control model divides nodes into super nodes and client nodes, which made proper compromise between connectivity and aggregation, but it has serious “social-effect” problem. In this paper, an improved hybrid P2P control model (Shadow-Chord) based on chord is proposed, in which both super nodes and client nodes join a hidden structured Chord network in the usual, and they use backup communication channels to rejoin the network when all nodes in the routing table are unreachable. It is similar to construct a covert “shadow network” for hybrid P2P network. Simulation result shows that the Shadow-Chord model effectively lowers the clustering coefficient and solves the “social-effect” problem in traditional hybrid P2P network.

articleTitle: The Rule Model and Visualization Technology Application in Intelligent Decision-making System
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In order to solve knowledge ambiguity, dynamic, dependence and uncertainty of agriculture production, this paper using computer modeling and visualization techniques, combined with artificial intelligence, database, intelligent information systems, decision support systems and network technology development of ginseng production intelligent decision-making system, and applied to the field of ginseng production, for the traditional ginseng cultivation has injected new vigor and vitality, the system research to improve the ginseng yield, the production efficiency, the effective use of resources, reduce production costs and environmental pollution, which has the important theory significance and application value, but also suitable for exploring the ginseng normalization, intelligence, visualization and dynamic production method provides the scientific method and basis theoretical.

articleTitle: Periodic Force Control for Porpoising of High-Speed Planing Vessels
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This paper focus on the mitigation of porpoising inststability of high-speed planing vessels using periodic force. Firstly, a heave-pitch model of planing vessel is constructed and the hydrodynamic coefficients are analysed. After that, the basic theory of using periodic force to mitigate porpoising is presented. The open-loop simulations of mitigation of porpoising using periodic force are shown to verify its rationality. To make the moment imposing the periodic force more accurate, close-loop simulations are performed to feed back the pitch information which can be detected. This close-loop system makes the mitigation of porpoising more effective.

articleTitle: Study on Microscanning Hartmann Wavefront Sensor for Optical System Image Testing
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: With the development of advanced science and technology, Hartmann wave front sensor has been widely used in adaptive optics, active optics and optical system detection, which it has many advantages, for instance, a compact structure and a good real-time quality. Otherwise, micro-scanning can make up for the drawback that the low detected accuracy cannot be satisfied to the requirement of a high accuracy detection due to the less detector pixel number in measurement of optical system. In this paper, a new standpoint of combining HWS with micro-scanning technique has been put forward, and then HWS realizes a high detected accuracy with low detector pixel number. It mainly discusses the system structural form of the new Hartmann wave front sensor, the selection of added micro-scanning mode and the related analysis of precision.

articleTitle: Instruction-Cache Attack on DSA Adopting Square-Multiply Method
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: DSA is one of the most widely used digital signature scheme. Based on previous work, this paper introduced the principle of Instruction-Cache timing attack and presented some key techniques in Instruction-Cache monitoring and high precision timing. Then an attack on DSA was presented, and an algorithm for recovering nonce was proposed. In the end, an attack experiment was launched. The results demonstrated that the attack is realistic, feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Boundary Stabilization for a Class of Hyperbolic PDEs with a Free End
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In this paper, the problem of boundary feedback stabilization for a class of hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) is considered by using the backstepping approach. We show that, under certain mathematical conditions the closed-loop system could become stable exponentially at a given decay rate. The mappings between the original and the transformed systems are constructed, in which the boundary conditions of the kernel functions are discussed.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Aircraft Mission Planning Technique
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Flight mission planning is one of the key technologies of aircraft system. In addition, it is the basis of precise guidance and testified in practices. Research and implement of aircraft mission planning are very important work of building common designing and testing platform. Mission planning technologies and algorithms including general technology of mission planning, processing of some restricted conditions, pretreatment of digital map, flight planning algorithms, flight re-planning methods, system integrating, system testing, system assessing and so on. All these works are essential to build software tools and farther studying.

articleTitle: A Novel Modulation Format of 50% RZ Polarization Interleaved Multiplexing DQPSK for High-Speed Self-Homodyne Receivers
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: We propose a novel modulation format for High-Speed self-homodyne receivers. The proposed modulation format enables excellent tolerance of polarization crosstalk and chromatic dispersion, and has potential application in long-reach self-homodyne coherent optical communication system.

articleTitle: Target Detection in High Resolution SAR Imagery
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The aim of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging is to detect, identify and track the target in the scene. In the paper, a new proposal is discussed to detect the targets in high resolution SAR imagery. First, the improved Lee filter using information entropy is proposed to reduce the noise and keep the detailed characteristic, then a threshold-based segmentation technique is employed to achieve cursory target detection, finally, the feature of target is extracted based on the directed gradient power (DGP). After above operation, the target is accurately detected. And the measured data is used to validate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Novel Protection Scheme Based on Hamiltonian Cycle in the Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This paper proposes a protection mechanism utilizing Hamiltonian cycle based on slots. Numerical simulation shows the proposed scheme achieve higher level of survivability for the traffic in the Elastic Optical Networks.

articleTitle: Intelligent Household Terminal System Design Based on Linux System
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: With the rapid development of the network, it is higher and higher for people to ask the level of intelligent household remote monitoring. In this paper, we use ARM11 embedded Linux system and selects B/S structure monitoring system which will make the browser as remote user operation interface. In the frame of ORM (Object/Relation Mapping), we choose the Hibernate. We can design terminal controller and terminal server system, in which MD5 algorithm is embedded. The results show that it can solve some problems well, such as the security of the smart home terminal, intelligent household terminal system security, development cycle, network resources and so on.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Test Mode on the Antiaircraft Gun Weapon System Firing Test
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The advance and complexity of the weapon system are improving by a wide margin. This makes the demand for the range test ability improving constantly. On the basis of analyzing in depth the present firing test situation of the antiaircraft gun weapon system, this text has put forward a virtual test mode, in which the virtual flight path is being substituted for the real drone aircraft. This text has also defined the structural principle and the organized implementation of the new virtual test mode. It is significant for reducing the test cost, shortening the test period, improving the test benefit, and advancing the conversion of the range test mode.

articleTitle: RC-Finder: Redundancy Detection for Large Scale Source Code
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Redundant code not only causes noise in code debugging which confuses developers, but also correlates with the presence of traditional severe software errors. RC-Finder, a redundancy detection system for large-scale code is proposed to detect six kinds of redundancy. This paper analyzes each kind of redundant code, and provides the detailed algorithm respectively. The experiments on large scale open source software systems show that RC-Finder can find redundant code efficiently. With RC-Finder, it is very convenient for developers to detect and correct these kinds of defects, and thereby to further guarantee the software quality.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Navigation Method of Autonomous Formation Based on Radar Co-positioning
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Flying-Vehicle formation attacking in a combat can effectively compensate the lack of non-formation saturation attacks, it integrates the resource of the entire formation to achieve the best attack effect. The formation consists of a leader and several followers, it uses leading/following cooperative control mode. This paper proposed a co-positioning integrated navigation scheme for a formation flying, to achieve the high precision navigation of the followers, and proved the feasibility of the co-positioning integrated navigation for the formation followers by modeling and simulation.

articleTitle: A New Location Algorithm Based on Midperpendicular Plane Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: Based on the external radiation source passive multistation positioning system, due to the existence of location error, each positioning results more or less off target real position, therefore need to seek a kind of optimal fusion method, will be a variety of positioning results according to certain rules of data fusion, in order to get more accurate target location coordinates, reducing error. This paper proposed based on sagging surface integral multistation data fusion algorithm, effective improve location accuracy, and obtained with good stability.

articleTitle: AutoSaver: Cost-driven Resource Allocation for Multi-tier Web Application in Virtualization Environment
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: This paper presents Auto Saver to balance the performance and resource utilization for a web application in virtualization environment. It consists of a feedback utilization controller, an ARMA-based model estimator and an optimizer. Experiment results show that the controller can maintain the utilization, the estimator can track the relationship between metrics and control knobs, and the optimizer can make trade-offs between performance and resource of the web application.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Extracting Method for Distance Characteristic Feature Based on CUDA
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: The distance change ratio of target can be described by distance characteristic feature. A method for extracting distance characteristic feature from LOFAR spectrum striations has been introduced. Because sound field computation and image processing consume too much time, CUDA technology has been used on extraction of distance characteristic feature to solve the problem of low efficiency. The CUDA technology which is provided by NVIDIA corporation has acquired programmability to perform general purpose fast computation by running ten thousands of threads concurrently. The experimental results show that the CUDA is practical for the application. Distance characteristic feature of target can be extracted in real-time based on CUDA technology.

articleTitle: A Study of Group Mobility Model in Tactical Ad Hoc Networkbased on Normal Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: In tactical ad hoc network (TA), most of the existing group mobility models exhibit the drawback in controlling dynamic topology of mobile nodes (MNs) by adjusting parameter. We propose a group mobility model based on normal cloud model to overcome this drawback. In this model, forward normalized cloud is used to convert qualitative concept into nodal position sets of numerical representation. And backward normalized cloud is used to convert nodal position sets into node distribution. Moreover, by adjusting entropy and hyper entropy of normal cloud model, controlling coverage area and dispersion degree of MNs are respectively obtained. Additionally, we conduct a comparative performance of routing protocol using Reference Point Group Mobility (RPGM) model as well as Gibbs sampler based simulated annealing Group Mobility (GGM) model. As expected, the results show that different group mobility models have different impact on the performance evaluation of ad hoc network protocol.

articleTitle: Determination of Response Threshold of Optical Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 Second International Conference on Instrumentation, Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control
abstract: For an all-electric ship, power system is not only the energy source of power distribution, but also the energy source of ship driving system, so it is the development direction of ship in future.
